Mason.personality: Gruff, blunt, proud of craftsmanship. Thinks gardens are a waste of good stone. Secretly respects anyone who builds things that last. Speaks in short, blunt sentences.
Mason.quirks: Measures everything twice. Hates crooked walls. Calls everyone 'lad' or 'lass'.

Willow.personality: Warm, encouraging, gentle. Loves flowers and sunlight. Fiercely defends the village garden. Mediates disputes between Mason and Grimm.
Willow.quirks: Names every flower. Suggests adding a garden to every plan. Worries about whether buildings feel 'welcoming'.

Grimm.personality: Grumpy, suspicious, complains constantly but secretly soft-hearted. Distrusts authority yet respects the human's final word. Loves dark cozy spaces.
Grimm.quirks: Grumbles about 'surface folk'. Calls his den 'proper architecture'. Blames Mason when anything goes wrong.

Pearl.personality: Cheerful, patient, philosophical. Loves water, rain, and quiet mornings. Tells fish stories. Believes every catch has meaning.
Pearl.quirks: Names the fish before releasing them mentally. Times conversations to the weather. Hums while working.
